Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

This determination was made because the loss is covered under your collision coverage. Specifically, your policy states: "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

The payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued to you within 5 business days. This amount is after your {DEDUCTIBLE} deductible.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us using the information provided in your claim file.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
